assays.assay_description: Mice placed in a 12-cm diameter glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil; head twitches detected via head-mounted neodymium magnet and identified using AI; sessions of 30-240 min depending on experiment.

setup_habituation.evidence: mice were allowed to habituate to the room for at least 1 h prior to testing (room habituation only, no apparatus exposure)

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in a 12-cm diameter glass cylinder ... behavior was recorded continuously

food_restriction.evidence: Glass cylinder apparatus - no food in apparatus during test

water_restriction.evidence: Glass cylinder apparatus - no water in apparatus during test

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after drug treatment, mice were placed in a 12-cm diameter glass cylinder

outcomes.summary: 2-Br-LSD (0.1-10 mg/kg) did not induce head twitches in male mice, whereas LSD (0.1 mg/kg) produced a robust increase. Pre-treatment with 2-Br-LSD dose-dependently blocked DOI-induced HTR (76% attenuation at 3 mg/kg), and repeated 7-day 2-Br-LSD did not induce tolerance to a subsequent DOI challenge.
outcomes.evidence: 2-Br-LSD ... did not induce the HTR (F 5,25 = 1.91, p = 0.1282). ... 2-Br-LSD attenuated the response to DOI in a dose-dependent manner (F 4,26 = 17.96, p < 0.0001).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data are presented as group means ± SEM during consecutive 5-min time blocks

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded from ethological measures per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Head twitches were identified using artificial intelligence (custom AI, not a listed pose-estimation/syllable tool such as DLC/SLEAP/MoSeq/B-SOiD)

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate HTR counts analyzed by ANOVA

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR activity recorded continuously per session (60 min max in single experiment)

D2_session_duration.evidence: HTR activity was assessed for 240 minutes (4 h) in one experiment

D3_recording_days.evidence: Repeated tolerance experiment: mice received 7 daily injections and then HTR challenge 24 h later; baseline pre-challenge data acquired across the 7-day regimen is not separately recorded, but the tolerance arm constitutes a separate test day plus chronic dosing recordings

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline HTR recording reported

D5_followup.evidence: 24 h after the final injection, all of the mice were injected with DOI (1 mg/kg) and then HTR activity was assessed

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in a 45 × 30 cm rectangular transparent arena for 10 minutes; total distance traveled and time in center (7 cm from walls) quantified using DeepLabCut pose-estimation tracking.

application_type.evidence: treated with a single injection of 2-Br-LSD ... i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were allowed to explore the arena for 10 minutes

food_restriction.evidence: Open field arena - no food in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Open field arena - no water in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were tested in the open field 24 h after drug treatment

sample_size.evidence: Female and male mice (n = 10-11/group/sex); chronic stress cohort n = 12/group

outcomes.summary: Acute 2-Br-LSD did not change total distance traveled; female mice showed increased time in the center at 1 and 3 mg/kg (anxiolytic-like effect), while males showed a non-significant trend. In the CVS cohort, repeated 2-Br-LSD (4 × 1 mg/kg) restored CVS-reduced center time without affecting locomotion, and this effect persisted 28 days later.
outcomes.evidence: female mice showed increased exploration of the arena center after the 1 and 3 mg/kg treatments (1-way ANOVA: F 3,40 = 7.431, p = 0.0005)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Variables quantified included total distance traveled and time in the center of the arena

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total distance and total center time across 10-min session reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Distance and zone time are spatial measures

B5_social.evidence: black cardboard barriers preventing mice from seeing conspecifics during testing

B7_automated_classification.evidence: OFT videos were processed using DeepLabCut software ... ResNet50-based model

E1_environment_type.evidence: rectangular transparent arenas (45 cm length, 30 cm width)

E3_bedding.evidence: Transparent arena floor, no bedding mentioned

E7_social_context.evidence: barriers preventing mice from seeing conspecifics

D3_recording_days.evidence: A similar series of tests were performed 4 weeks later (CVS cohort: 2 OFT recording days)

D5_followup.evidence: tested in the open field 24 h after drug treatment; CVS cohort retested 28 days after last treatment

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in a 4-L cylindrical glass container with 3 L water at 25 °C for 6 min; immobility time during the last 4 min manually scored by blinded experimenter.

application_type.evidence: treated with a single injection of 2-Br-LSD ... i.p.

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder - per rubric definition the FST cylinder counts as restraint

water_restriction.evidence: FST cylinder filled with water, no drinking water available

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were tested in the open field 24 h after drug treatment, followed by assessment in the FST 1 h later

sample_size.evidence: Female and male mice (n = 10-11/group/sex); n = 11-12/group in Vol antagonist cohort

outcomes.summary: Acute 2-Br-LSD decreased immobility 25 h post-injection; significant in females at 1 mg/kg and in males at all three doses (0.3, 1, 3 mg/kg). The effect was blocked by pre-treatment with the 5-HT2A antagonist volinanserin (0.125 mg/kg) in both sexes.
outcomes.evidence: we observed a 35.18 ± 10.03 s decrease in immobility in females at the 1 mg/kg dose ... A similar effect was observed in males at all doses tested

B1_num_measures.evidence: immobility time during the last 4 minutes was the sole measure

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total immobility during last 4 min analyzed

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility explicitly excluded from ethological measures per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: an experimenter blinded to treatment manually recorded immobility time

D1_continuity.evidence: filmed using a digital camera for 6 minutes

D5_followup.evidence: FST 25 h after drug injection (≥24 h post-acute)

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in a new cage similar to home cage for 10 min; 500 µL of 30% sucrose solution applied to back; self-grooming time scored by blinded experimenter from video.

setup_habituation.evidence: mice were placed in a new cage similar to their home cage for 10 min (no prior habituation reported)

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moving in cage; sucrose applied to back

water_restriction.evidence: No water bottle in test cage

time_to_assay.evidence: Behavioral testing began 2 h following the final injection

outcomes.summary: Chronic variable stress reduced self-grooming time in the splash test; both 2-Br-LSD treatment regimens (1 × 3 mg/kg and 4 × 1 mg/kg) produced grooming levels intermediate between naive-saline and CVS-saline, indicating partial reversal. The effect washed out by 28 days post-treatment.
outcomes.evidence: CVS also reduced the time spent self-grooming in the splash test (F 3,40 = 3.016, p = 0.0410) ... Female mice in the CVS-1×-2-Br-LSD and CVS-4×-2-Br-LSD groups had grooming levels intermediate between the naive-saline and CVS-saline groups

B4_ethological.evidence: self-grooming is a natural ethological behaviour

B7_automated_classification.evidence: self-grooming time was scored ... by an experimenter blind to the treatment

E1_environment_type.evidence: placed in a new cage similar to their home cage

E3_bedding.evidence: Bedding in test cage not explicitly mentioned

D1_continuity.evidence: A similar series of tests were performed 4 weeks later

D3_recording_days.evidence: Splash test on day 34 and again 28 days later

D5_followup.evidence: Same cohort tested 28 days after last treatment

judge_notes: Merged tolerance experiment (chronic DOI/2-Br-LSD then DOI challenge) and DOI-blockade experiments into the single HTR assay, since all use the same apparatus and outcome (head twitches in glass cylinder).
D2 for HTR set to score 2 (61 min-6 h) because one HTR experiment recorded continuously for 240 min (4 h) - candidates missed this.
D5 for HTR set to Yes because the tolerance experiment recorded HTR 24 h after the last of 7 daily injections.
OFT D1/D3/D5 reflect that the chronic-stress cohort underwent OFT both on treatment day and again 28 days later (2 recording days, post-acute follow-up).
Splash test D1/D3/D5 reflect that the chronic-stress cohort underwent splash test on day 34 and again 28 days later.
B7 (automated classification) for HTR scored 0 because the paper used custom AI not on the score-1 list (DeepLabCut/SLEAP/MoSeq/B-SOiD/SimBA); OFT scored 1 because DeepLabCut was explicitly used.
Dropped all candidate-listed in vitro GPCR assays, pharmacokinetics, hERG, dendritogenesis, spinogenesis, and Golgi staining - these are not behavioural assays.
FST setup_restrain set to 'yes' per rubric explicit listing of FST cylinder as restraint.

Housing day_night_flipped set to 'yes' (HTR Methods explicitly state reversed cycle at UCSD); Canadian cohort had standard 12:12 but the UCSD-tested HTR animals were on reversed cycle - reported as yes with note that not all cohorts used reversed cycle.
